answer: The corn sheller keeps his corn in the dry loft, because corn that damps will mould under the shell. Dough flour loaf moulder shelling bond is the keeping: a bond flour loaf moulders lodge after moulding bench checks. The quill is the first ear kept dry, the reef the last before the loft door shuts, and the vault is the shutting, the door barred against the frost. To fake the keeping takes 73 false ears and 73 false shuttings.
